steps.title: Discovery call
steps.description: We talk through your goals, users, and must-haves. I ask the questions that prevent expensive surprises later.

steps.title: Scope & plan
steps.description: You get a written scope with milestones, timeline, and price, so you know exactly what you are paying for.

steps.title: Build in the open
steps.description: I share a live preview link and regular progress updates. You see real working software, not just status reports.

steps.title: Launch & handover
steps.description: I deploy, test with real data, and hand over the code, accounts, and notes. You own everything.
